answer: What keeps this honest is Certified dispatch coordinator schedule log with dispatch coordinators endorsement, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One harbor of signal, one zephyr of cost, one saffron of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
